newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Seven Colombian truck thieves die in shoot-out.
newsitem.headline: Seven Colombian truck thieves die in shoot-out.

text.p: Seven suspected members of a gang of truck thieves died in a shoot-out with police in a southern area of Colombia's capital, officials said on Monday.
The firefight broke out late on Sunday as police, acting on a tip, confronted the gang as it attempted to steal loaded tractor-trailers from a truck park.
A number of weapons, ammunition and hand-grenades were seized, police sources said. Six jewelry thieves died in gunfight with police in southeastern Bogota 10 days ago.
